simplesect.para: The steps on this page need to be done once on a given host machine

listitem.para:
Following are the options to build and load an example program
Build and Load together in a single click
Right click on the project and select 'Debug Project (F5)' option <style>div.image img[src="ccs_debug.jpg"]{width:30%}</style> Debug CCS project
It performs the following sequence
Builds the project
Launches the Target Configuration based on the 'ccxml' file included in projectspec
Connects to the target core
Loads the program onto the target core
Build and Load separately
Build
Right click on the project and select either 'Build Project(s)' or 'Rebuild Project(s)' option <style>div.image img[src="ccs_build_project.jpg"]{width:25%}</style> Build CCS project
Upon successful build, example program is generated
Launch the CCS Debug Session
Connect to the target core
Load the program
